text: August nineteenth. Kettering, Ohio. Officers find a stolen Chevy Suburban parked at a gas pump.
The same SUV ran from police the day before. So this time, they box it in.
He doesn't give up. He rams the cruisers, again and again.
Officers standing next to those cars are nearly hit.
He keeps revving the engine and spinning the tires. So they move in on foot.
A window punch. Then the Taser.
On the driver's seat, a handgun. It turned out to be stolen.
He pleaded guilty, and got five years of probation.
